entries.name: Etiquette, courtesy, and first impressions
entries.scope: Use greetings, punctuality, dress, manners, attention, and context to communicate respect.
entries.evidence_of_progress: Others experience the interaction as considerate and appropriately composed.

measurement.minimum_standard: Use at least two independent evidence types, including one behavioral, observer, artifact, objective, or longitudinal indicator; self-report alone is insufficient for score advancement.

entries.name: Manipulation and coercion literacy
entries.scope: Recognize guilt, intimidation, gaslighting, love-bombing, false urgency, triangulation, and exploitative reciprocity.
entries.evidence_of_progress: Responds through clarification, evidence, boundaries, support, or distance.

measurement.minimum_standard: Use at least two independent evidence types, including one behavioral, observer, artifact, objective, or longitudinal indicator; self-report alone is insufficient for score advancement.

entries.name: High-context, indirect, and face-sensitive communication
entries.scope: Recognize that respect, disagreement, refusal, and emotion may be communicated through implication, timing, silence, hierarchy, or relational context.
entries.evidence_of_progress: Can interpret indirect signals cautiously and adapt without treating one communication style as universally superior.

measurement.minimum_standard: Use at least two independent evidence types, including one behavioral, observer, artifact, objective, or longitudinal indicator; self-report alone is insufficient for score advancement.

entries.name: Intercultural communication and code-switching
entries.scope: Adapt to different norms of directness, hierarchy, turn-taking, emotion, time, privacy, and formality while preserving integrity.
entries.evidence_of_progress: Can communicate effectively across cultures and explain what was adapted and what boundary remained.

entries.name: Language access and communication accommodation

entries.evidence_of_progress: Another person can participate meaningfully because a communication barrier was reduced.

entries.name: Initiating connection

measurement.minimum_standard: Use at least two independent evidence types, including one behavioral, observer, artifact, objective, or longitudinal indicator; self-report alone is insufficient for score advancement.
